comment: Source of truth for the hidden GPU driver packages. scripts/build_gpu_catalog.py builds every package listed here, signs it, writes kernel/drivers/gpu/pins.h (matching table + public key) and build/gpu-drivers/ (what is uploaded to GitHub). There is deliberately NO Store listing for any of these packages: the kernel detects the primary display adapter and downloads only the matching package in the background.
